title: Acyclic complexes satisfy two-out-of-three in distinguished triangles
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site and $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings on $\mathcal C$. In the homotopy category of cochain complexes of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], with acyclicity as in [def-pc-acyclic-complex-modules] and distinguished triangles as in [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], the full subcategory of acyclic complexes is triangulated. Consequently, for every distinguished triangle, if two of its three objects are represented by acyclic complexes, then the third object is represented by an acyclic complex.
